releases.description: Experience the biggest update yet. We've completely rebuilt the audio engine, introduced cloud sync, and added an adaptive UI that changes colors with your music.
changelog: Introduced Cloud Sync with audio.com integration.
Added AI Stem Separation for Karaoke mode.
Complete UI refresh with Adaptive Theme.
Reduced memory usage by 40% during library scanning.
Fixed an issue where the app would freeze when seeking rapidly.
Resolved a memory leak in the visualizer.
Corrected file association errors on Windows 10.
Added real-time wave visualizer with gradient fill.
Improved search performance for libraries over 50,000 tracks.
